items.name: Galley Stores: card text 2,000 pet exp

data.description:
The galley still stocks a larder for a crew that does not eat. A companion that does grows strong on it.

Gives 2,000 pet experience to your active pet. It must be ready for battle, have its look generated for its current rank, and not be on a task, or the experience is lost.
